clips.title: The story
paras: At Islen Waterseer's shore, a young Horde shaman receives Water Sapta for a journey across the Great Sea. The trial leads from the Barrens to Silverpine Forest, where a spring has been corrupted.

Among Horde shaman, a sapta is a draught made to open the senses to the world's spirits. To ordinary eyes, a stream may look calm and a pond still. Drink a sapta, and the veil of the physical world parts, showing the elementals that dwell in the water.

Islen Waterseer gives the shaman the draught after they have shown their devotion to the spirits. She lives alone on the barren shore south of Ratchet. She sends the initiate across the Great Sea, away from Kalimdor's dry valleys, to Silverpine Forest. There, an elemental corruption is poisoning Lordaeron's streams, and the shaman must face it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Take the water sapta and find the corrupted pool of water in Silverpine, friend. I have great faith in your abilities.
